name: boxctl
description: Run Claude Code's Bash commands in a boxctl.io microVM instead of on your machine.

autostart.title: Auto-on at session start
autostart.description: Turn remote bash on by itself whenever a session starts, without /boxctl:on. session: a new box for each session, destroyed when it ends. project: the project's box, kept across sessions. exec: a fresh box per command. off: Bash stays local until you run /boxctl:on.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: How the project gets onto a session or project box. sync: copied there before every command and back after, so the box and Claude's file edits always match. copy: copied once, when the box is turned on. git: git clone of its origin at the local commit. none: an empty directory. .gitignore'd files are never copied either way.

size.title: Box size
size.description: Size of boxes the plugin creates (boxctl sizes). Empty uses boxctl's default.

image.title: Boot image
image.description: Image of boxes the plugin creates (boxctl images). Empty uses claude-agent: debian-slim plus git, rsync, jq, ripgrep and make.
